calls.statement:
SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, s.store_id = 999 AS is999, s.store_id >= 900 AS is_web_or_test, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test,
 count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl,
 sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category FROM fact_sales_line f
 LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30')
SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) m,
 count(*) n_all, sum((store_id IS NULL)::INT) no_store, sum((category IS NULL)::INT) no_prod,
 sum((gross_amount IS NULL OR net_amount IS NULL)::INT) null_amt,
 sum((abs(gross_amount - round(net_amount*(1+vat_rate),2))>0.02)::INT) vat_mismatch,
 sum((quantity<=0)::INT) nonpos_qty, sum((net_amount<0)::INT) neg_net,
 count(DISTINCT vat_rate) n_rates, string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(vat_rate AS VARCHAR), ',') rates,
 sum(CASE WHEN store_id<900 AND category<>'ZZ Test' THEN gross_amount END) store_gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN store_id<900 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND staff_purchase_flag THEN gross_amount END) staff_gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' AND store_id<900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wb_in_store
FROM l GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date d, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT business_date d, store_id, net_sales_before_returns rn FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
 WHERE store_id<900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30')
SELECT date_trunc('month', COALESCE(f.d, r.d)) m, sum(f.net) fact_net, sum(r.rn) rpt_net, count(*) n_storedays,
 sum((f.net IS NULL)::INT) missing_in_fact, sum((r.rn IS NULL)::INT) missing_in_rpt, sum((abs(f.net-r.rn)>0.01)::INT) mismatched
FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.d=r.d AND f.store_id=r.store_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, count(*) n_store_lines_matching_web_orders, sum(f.gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, count(*) lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.vat_rate=0.24 THEN f.gross_amount END) g24, sum(CASE WHEN f.vat_rate=0.255 THEN f.gross_amount END) g255
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
